text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, huff!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I... I did it! I was able to run in the Oka<n>Sho with
everything I got!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Male Dober Fan
text_block_list.text:
That was incredible, Mejiro Dober!<n>Do your best at
the Japanese Oaks<n>too!

text_block_list.name: Female Dober Fan
text_block_list.text:
Dober! You were so cool! I'll come<n>see you at the
Japanese Oaks for<n>sure!

text_block_list.name: Female Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Watching you run has made me a<n>total fan! I'll
definitely watch your<n>next race!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The venue is filled with cheers for<n>Mejiro Dober
after witnessing such a<n>spectacular performance
from the<n>up-and-comer of the Mejiro family!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: She's done well to win the favor of<n>the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Still, she's never experienced being<n>under the
scrutiny of so many. How<n>will she react, I wonder...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (E-everyone's looking at me.)

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Oh, number eight, Mejiro Dober is<n>rounding the last
turn!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
She stumbled and fell after coming<n>out of the gate,
but she hasn't given<n>up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (Oh no... This feeling...)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: You're doing your best! Just keep it<n>up!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Just a little farther! You can do it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (...No. No, no, no, no!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Why are those stupid memories<n>coming back
now?! Things are<n>completely different from back
then!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I ran well today! I finished the race<n>and did
amazing, so why—)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone's yelling. Their voices,<n>their eyes. Their
eyes are on me.<n>They're looking at me. Their
eyes—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Am I going to have to run amidst all<n>these stares
and voices... forever?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I have to run... in all this chaos?

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... gasp...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (No, no, no, no! I promised! I promised<n>Bright!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I can't stop shaking... Stop it! Stop it!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
When I head out to meet Mejiro<n>Dober after her
amazing<n>performance, I notice something's<n>off. She
looks pale and she's<n>trembling.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Don't worry about me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Nothing's wrong! I'll be able to run in<n>the Japanese
Oaks just fine!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'll run just as well at the Japanese<n>Oaks, so don't
worry about a thing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I have to! I can't afford to do<n>otherwise!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'll be perfectly fine...<n>everything's fine!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober is as pale as a ghost...<n>She hardly
even looks at me as she<n>mumbles to herself. She
runs off<n>before I can say anything.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A few days after the Oka Sho, while<n>we're training
for the Japanese<n>Oaks...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober is immersing herself<n>fully in her
training, but I can tell<n>something's still off...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A shadow clouds her expression, and<n>she's
constantly distracted, as<n>though she's trying to
shake off a<n>thought she just can't get rid of.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hello. Apologies for interrupting your<n>training.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping I could speak to you for<n>a few
minutes about Dober.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
She's been acting strange ever since<n>the Oka Sho,
hasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I might know what Dober is struggling<n>with at the
moment.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
For that reason, I'm afraid I must<n>impose a request
upon you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Would you mind if I spoke with her in<n>private?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
About what she's fighting against. I<n>wish to reveal
its true nature to her,<n>as I don't think she realizes
what it<n>is.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, this is ultimately a problem<n>between you
and her. If you don't<n>approve of my meddling, you
are free<n>to decline.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I know that something happened at<n>the Oka Sho, but
I have no idea what I<n>should say to make her feel
better.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I want to do whatever I can to support<n>her, and right
now, the best thing to<n>do is ask for help.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Thank you for allowing<n>me to speak
with her.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
In return, I promise to dispel the<n>vexation you grip in
your fists and<n>honor the sentiment which you hold
for her in your heart.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's not until Air Groove says that that<n>I finally
realize my hands are curled<n>into tight fists.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We don't have much time before the<n>Japanese
Oaks. For now, all I can do<n>is hope that Mejiro
Dober will be<n>back to normal in time.
